'''Jos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Jos served as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[G'mi Moa]]'' and was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] after the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Gunda Mabin/Legends|Gunda Mabin]]. The female [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Ugmush]] recognized Jos's skills and purchased him, putting him to work aboard her ship, the ''[[Zicreex]]''.
